howToUse: Each key under 'assets' maps one generated image or video to its ready-to-post caption. Automation (Make.com/Sheets or any future autopost step) should join on 'assetPath' — the exact relative path from the koolestpro-cowork-v2 project root — or on the key itself if working key-first. 'status' tracks whether that specific asset+caption pairing has actually been posted; it is separate from, and does not affect, the pipeline item's own status in ridwan_content_system_updated.html (which only ever reaches 'Ready', never 'Published', per CLAUDE.md). HALOS has no pre-written caption library like kura-social-content.md — this file IS that library, started fresh on the first HALOS Template Showcase run.

TS-HALOS-PP01-COVER-VID.caption:
Built a post-purchase page for HALOS, a red light therapy brand I made up. It's a concept build, not a client.

Most thank-you pages say thanks and stop. This one keeps going:
✅ the order confirmation sits on top, so nobody wonders if it went through
✅ a one-time offer for a second panel at $99, shipped in the same box
✅ an honest timeline that admits week one does nothing
✅ reviews, a short care guide and a three-email check-in signup

Week one took the longest to write. Telling a new buyer they won't see anything yet feels risky, but I'd rather they hear it from the page than decide it's broken in week two.

Need a store like this built? Start here: koolestpro.com/services/page-build
